description: This file defines a PHP class Operator within the SuiteCRM API, handling filtering operators for JSON API filters. It includes methods for validating, converting, and processing operator strings, and managing operands in SQL queries.

classes.name: Operator
classes.description: Represents a filter operator in the JSON API, providing validation, conversion, and handling of operators and their operands.

methods.name: Operator::__construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the container interface for dependency injection.

methods.name: Operator::toFilterTag
methods.description: Replaces 'operator' placeholder in the tag with a specific operator string.

methods.name: Operator::stripFilterTag
methods.description: Removes the filter tag syntax from an operator string, extracting the core operator.

methods.name: Operator::isValid
methods.description: Validates if a given string matches the expected operator format regex.

methods.name: Operator::isOperator
methods.description: Checks if a given string matches the current operator.

methods.name: Operator::hasOperator
methods.description: Determines if a filter string contains an operator matching the format.

methods.name: Operator::totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the total number of operands expected; default is 1.

methods.name: Operator::toSqlOperands
methods.description: Converts an array of operands into a SQL-compatible string, quoting numeric and string types appropriately.
